cohort: The study included 104 nulliparous diabetic pregnant women.
finding: Ultrasonographic estimated fetal weight showed a noticeable correlation with mode of delivery, and its utilization was associated with an increased likelihood of cesarean delivery in nulliparous diabetic pregnant women.
mod_finding: Utilizing ultrasound for estimating fetal weight was found to lead to an increased likelihood of cesarean delivery.
cross-section timing: Fetal weight was recorded during obstetric ultrasound (gestational age > 34 weeks), and fetal outcomes were assessed post-delivery.
